knives_as_swords.consent.message:
To convert knife models from your own game files, Knives as Swords uses Source2Viewer-CLI, an open-source (MIT) tool by the ValveResourceFormat project. It is not bundled with the mod.

Download version %s (about 50 MB) from github.com/ValveResourceFormat now? The download is checked against a pinned checksum, kept in this game folder, and only runs on your machine. Nothing is uploaded.
